text: Start {feature} when there is no {entity} at all (a new gym or a new member).
sees: An empty state in plain words that says what to do next
must_not: A blank screen, an endless spinner, an error, or a wrong total such as NaN for {entity}

text: Start {feature} when exactly one {entity} exists.
sees: The one {entity}, with words in the singular
must_not: Plural words for one {entity}, a divide-by-zero figure, or a list that looks broken with one row

text: Start {feature} when 500 or more {entity} rows exist.
sees: The list opens in a few seconds and scrolls; every count is the true total
must_not: A count that stops at a page size, missing rows of {entity}, or a screen that freezes

text: Use the longest allowed name or text for {entity} (a 60-letter name, a 500-letter note), then do {feature}.
sees: The text wraps or is cut with dots; every button can still be reached
must_not: Text over other text, a button pushed off the screen, or the {entity} saved with its text cut without a word to the user

text: Type Hinglish and Devanagari text into every text box of {feature}.
sees: The same letters shown back everywhere the {entity} is shown
must_not: Boxes or question marks in place of letters, or a search that cannot find the {entity}

text: Put emoji into the name or note used by {feature}.
sees: The emoji shown back, or a clear message that it is not allowed
must_not: A failed save with no message, or a broken {entity} in a list, a message, an export or a receipt

text: Do {feature} when the member photo or the gym logo is missing.
sees: A neat stand-in (initials or the default mark)
must_not: A broken-picture mark, an empty gap that shifts the layout, or another gym's logo

text: Do {feature} for a member who has paid only part of what is due.
sees: Paid, due and total, and the three add up
must_not: The {entity} shown as fully paid or fully unpaid, or a balance that does not add up

text: Do {feature} after a payment was refunded or reversed.
sees: The refund shown as a refund; totals go down by that amount
must_not: The refunded money still counted as income, or the {entity} still marked paid

text: Do {feature} with a price of zero (a free plan, a full discount).
sees: A zero amount shown as free, and the journey still finishes
must_not: A payment step that cannot be passed, a dues reminder for zero, or a receipt with a wrong amount

variant: dates at plan start and end
text: Do {feature} for a membership that starts today, and again for one that ends today.
sees: Day counts that include both the first and the last day as the gym expects
must_not: A member shown as expired on the last paid day, or as active before the first day

text: Do step {n} of {feature} at 23:59 IST and finish after 00:00 IST.
sees: The {entity} dated on the day the user means, the same on every screen
must_not: The {entity} landing on the wrong day, counted twice, or missing from both days

text: Do {feature} on the 1st of a month, with data from the last days of the month before.
sees: Month totals start fresh and last month's figures stay as they were
must_not: Last month's {entity} counted in this month, or an empty month shown as an error

text: Do {feature} on a Monday, with data from Sunday.
sees: Week figures start on the day the app says the week starts
must_not: Sunday's {entity} in the new week, or a streak or weekly count that resets a day early or late

text: Do {feature} for a member whose plan ends today.
sees: The member still active today, with a clear word that today is the last day
must_not: The member locked out or marked expired today, or shown as fine with no warning

text: Do {feature} for a member who joined today.
sees: The member counted as joined today, with day 1 figures
must_not: A minus day count, the member left out of today's lists, or yesterday's date on the {entity}

variant: phone set to another time zone
text: Set the phone to another time zone (for example Dubai or New York), then do {feature}.
sees: The gym's dates and times as the gym in India means them
must_not: The {entity} moved to another day, or a time shown without saying whose clock it is

text: Press back at step {n} of {feature}.
sees: The screen before, or a question to keep or drop what was typed
must_not: A half-saved {entity}, typed text lost without a warning, or the app closing

text: Close the app (swipe it away) at step {n} of {feature}, then open it again.
sees: Either nothing was saved, or the {entity} is whole; the app says which
must_not: A half-saved {entity}, a double {entity} after trying again, or a stuck screen on reopening

text: Lock the phone at step {n} of {feature}, wait two minutes, unlock.
sees: The same screen with the same typed values
must_not: A lost draft of {entity}, a timer or count that stopped, or a sign-out with no reason given

text: Take a phone call at step {n} of {feature}, then come back to the app.
sees: The same screen and values as before the call
must_not: The app starting over, a lost {entity} draft, or sound and timers left in a wrong state

text: Turn the internet off at step {n} of {feature}, carry on, then turn it back on.
sees: A plain word that the work is saved on the device or could not be saved, and it is sent once when the internet is back
must_not: A lost {entity}, a double {entity} after the retry, or a success message for a save that failed

text: Tap the main button of step {n} of {feature} twice, fast.
sees: One result; the button shows it is busy
must_not: Two rows of {entity}, two charges, two messages sent, or two screens opened

text: Two staff do step {n} of {feature} for the same {entity} at the same time on two devices.
sees: One change wins and the other person is told, or both are kept
must_not: One person's change of {entity} lost without a word, a double {entity}, or two different truths on the two screens after a refresh

text: Change the language setting, then do {feature}.
sees: Every word of the journey in the chosen language
must_not: Mixed languages on one screen, a raw text key, or a {entity} that changes meaning

text: Change the theme setting, then do {feature}.
sees: Every screen of the journey in the new theme, all text easy to read
must_not: Text the same colour as its background, or one screen left in the old theme

text: Change the units setting (kg to lb, km to miles), then do {feature}.
sees: Every figure in the new unit, with its unit named
must_not: An old {entity} shown with the new unit name but the old number, or a saved value changed by rounding

text: Turn the alert setting that belongs to {feature} off, do the journey, then turn it on and do it again.
sees: No alert while off; one alert while on
must_not: An alert sent while off, no alert while on, or the {entity} itself not saved because alerts are off

text: Refuse the phone permission {feature} asks for (camera, notifications, location, health data, contacts), then do the journey.
sees: A plain reason why the permission is needed and another way to carry on
must_not: A crash, an empty screen, a prompt that returns on every tap, or a {entity} saved as if the permission was given

text: Do {feature} on a phone screen 360 px wide.
sees: Every word, figure and button of the journey in full
must_not: Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other

text: Do {feature} on a phone screen 390 px wide.
sees: Every word, figure and button of the journey in full
must_not: Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other

text: Do {feature} on a tablet, upright and on its side.
sees: A layout that uses the width and stays easy to read
must_not: A thin phone column stretched wide, a sheet that cannot be closed, or lost values after turning the tablet

text: Do {feature} on a laptop browser (1366 px wide) with a mouse and a keyboard.
sees: The whole journey works with the mouse and with Tab and Enter
must_not: A step that needs a swipe or a long press, or a button that the keyboard cannot reach

text: Set the device font to its largest size, then do {feature}.
sees: Bigger text that wraps; every button can still be reached
must_not: Text cut off, text over other text, or the main button pushed out of reach

text: Do {feature} in dark mode.
sees: Every text, icon and chart easy to read
must_not: Dark text on a dark background, a white flash between screens, or an unreadable chart or picture

text: Do {feature} in light mode.
sees: Every text, icon and chart easy to read
must_not: Pale text on a white background, or a part of the screen left dark

text: Do {feature} with the app set to Hinglish.
sees: Every label of the journey in Hinglish, fitting its space
must_not: English left on a button of the journey, or a longer Hinglish word cut off

text: On the old version, do {feature} up to step {n}; update the app; open it and carry on.
sees: The journey carries on or starts again cleanly, with nothing lost that was saved
must_not: A crash on first open, a lost or half-saved {entity}, or a step that the new version no longer understands

variant: old saved data in the new version
text: With {entity} saved by the old version, update the app, then do {feature}.
sees: The old {entity} shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old {entity} missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

text: Do step {n} of {feature} on the phone with the watch connected; look at both. Then do it from the watch.
sees: Phone and watch show the same {entity} within a few seconds
must_not: Two different values on phone and watch, a double {entity} made by both, or the watch stuck on the old state

variant: panel on phone and panel on laptop
text: Do step {n} of {feature} in the panel on a phone, with the same login open in the panel on a laptop.
sees: The laptop shows the change after a refresh or by itself
must_not: The laptop saving over the phone's change with old values, or the two never agreeing

text: Do step {n} of {feature} on one side (member app or gym panel); look at the same {entity} on the other side.
sees: The other side shows the same facts, in its own words
must_not: The member and the gym seeing different facts about the {entity}, or the member seeing what only the gym may see
